study: Gothenburg 1955–1975 apartment buildings; exploratory untuned baseline v1

selection.year_rule: most qualifying records per schema, earlier year breaks ties

target: reported delivered district heat for heating plus DHW, before automatic normal-year correction
primary_energy_comparison: not performed; normal-year correction, property electricity and regime-specific accounting unresolved
raw_meter_comparison: not established: old values allocated; newer values can include normal-use adjustments

assumptions.envelope_source: ARCHIVE/FINDINGS/FINDINGS.md §4.1 TABULA reference; literature-informed assumptions, not surveyed buildings
assumptions.basement: none modelled; no heated basement declared does not prove no unheated basement
assumptions.use_note: fixed historical BEN-era DHW baseline and conventional household/person assumptions, not observed occupant behaviour
assumptions.ground_source: EnergyPlus simple Ground building-surface boundary, uncalibrated
assumptions.delivery_note: simplified building-boundary district heat; 5 kWh/m² is assumed net unrecovered distribution/VVC loss, not gross VVC loss
assumptions.renovation_history: not inferred from EPC recommendations or value year
assumptions.area: footprints unchanged; gains, airflow and DHW use reported Atemp via density conversion

sensitivity.weather: same frozen models with actual 2017/2018 Gothenburg and Landvetter TMYx 2004–2018; spatial and year differences confounded

inference: small selected engineering pilot, not independent national holdout; no ASHRAE monthly acceptance claim
